claim: Chapter's small-business product set (Zelle, Transfers, Bill Pay, Wires, Mobile deposit, ACH Service) is complete for SMB Online Banking money movement.
finding: The Small Business Online Banking page lists a 'MANAGE YOUR MONEY' tab set of Account Services | Mobile Banking | Bill Pay | Online Payroll | ACH Services | Wire Transfer | Zelle. 'Online Payroll' (Truist Online Payroll) is absent from the research dataset, research.md and the gap-fill capture. The product page says it pays employees by direct deposit or printed check, calculates and files taxes, is for 1-100 employees, and needs enrollment through Truist online business banking. Read in the browser and with WebFetch.
resolution: Add TFC-P09-S04 'Truist Online Payroll' (small_business; ACH_ORIGINATION; WEB): direct deposit at no extra cost or printed checks; automatic tax calculation and filing; employee access to pay records/W-2/1099; QuickBooks, AccountEdge, Zoho Books, Xero integrations; 1-100 employees; low monthly fee (more for >50 employees); enroll after registering for business online banking. Vendor not disclosed.

claim: Small-business Online Banking lacks documented in-product dual approval for ACH/wires (contact-validation codes instead); dual control confirmed only in Treasury Manager [S013][S045].
finding: This weakness contradicts the chapter's own strength and the TFC-J10 and TFC-J14 steps. The current Online & Mobile Banking for Business Service Agreement (eff. 9/17/2026, read in full in the browser with pdf.js) has a Dual Approval Feature in both the ACH Transfer Service and the Wire Transfer Service sections. It requires an 'Approver' or 'Approver Admin' and must be enabled by the Business Profile Owner. The 4/8/2026 agreement (S906) has the same clause.
resolution: Delete the weakness. No replacement is needed; the dual-approval strength stands (add 'Approver Admin' role and 'must be enabled by the Business Profile Owner').

claim: Public help content is thin: no bill-pay or mobile-deposit help pages, help-center index 404s; key journey details live only in PDF agreements [S005][S035].
finding: The gap-fill (S901-S905) found 18 mobile-deposit FAQs and 10 bill-pay FAQs through truist.com site search. In the browser I confirmed that the site search returns FAQ answers (for example q=international returns 6 FAQ answers, including the SWIFT/BIC FAQ). The finding still holds that there are no dedicated product pages (the /online-banking/bill-pay and /help-center URLs fail, per the blocked-pages list). A second, later weakness already says this more accurately.
resolution: Remove the first-wave line. Reword the later 'Public help content gap persists' weakness to: 'No dedicated Bill Pay, external-transfer or help-center landing pages (/online-banking/bill-pay and /help-center fail); FAQs are reachable only through truist.com site search (Zelle 39, mobile deposit 18, bill pay 10 results) and there is no external-transfer FAQ; key rules live in the service agreements.'

claim: Five first-wave app-version entries: 'App 4.0.0 (Feb 2025): Security Center checklist, external-account linking from home, recurring Zelle insights'; 'App 4.1.0 (Apr 2025): Truist Assist everywhere, add card to digital wallet (Paze), bill-pay payee groupings'; 'App 4.5.0 (Sep 2025) / 4.6.0 (Oct 2025): improved bill-payment confirmations...'; 'App 5.1/5.2 ... 5.4.0 ... 5.6.0 ...'.
finding: The App Store version history (WebFetch, plus the browser for 5.9.0) contradicts these entries. 4.1.0 (04/10/2025) is 'Bug fixes and Enhancements'. Assist everywhere, add-card-to-wallet and payee groupings are in 4.0.0 (02/26/2025). The Security Center checklist is in 3.4.0 (11/14/2024). Improved bill-payment confirmations are in 4.4.0 (08/14/2025). Account/routing payments are in 5.3.0. Mobile-deposit guidance and Siri are in 5.5.0. 5.6.0 is bug fixes. The chapter keeps both the wrong entries and the 'CORRECTION' entry, so it contradicts itself.
resolution: Remove the four first-wave app-version lines. Replace the CORRECTION line with: 'App releases (App Store): 3.2.0 Jul 26 2024 device widgets (Zelle, transfers, check deposit); 3.4.0 Nov 14 2024 Security Center checklist, external-account linking from home, recurring bill-pay/Zelle insights; 4.0.0 Feb 26 2025 Truist Assist everywhere, add card to device digital wallet, bill-pay payee groupings, Plan & Track; 4.4.0 Aug 14 2025 improved bill-payment activity/confirmations and external-account verification; 4.5.0 Sep 10 2025 payee-list cleanup; 4.6.0 Oct 27 2025 Assist search, 24-month deposit history, real-time external-account verification; 4.7.0 Dec 4 2025 security-settings navigation; 5.1.0 Feb 12 2026 multi-payee bill payments; 5.3.0 Apr 14 2026 new ways to pay using account and routing number; 5.4.0 May 7 2026 five saved User IDs; 5.5.0 Jun 25 2026 clearer mobile-deposit guidance, Siri balances; 5.9.0 Oct 28 2026 24-month credit-card history and streamlined check deposit [S919].'

claim: Paze positioning: 'Card Controls > select card > Digital Wallets > Paze > Get started/Activate; also 'Add card to digital wallet' (app 4.1.0)'.
finding: The Card Controls path is correct. The App Store note is 4.0.0 (not 4.1.0) and reads 'Add your credit or debit card to your digital wallet—no manual entry needed'. It does not mention Paze, and the wording describes push-provisioning to device wallets. Paze activation is a separate flow that redirects to the Paze site.
resolution: TFC-P07 positioning: 'Card Controls > select card > Digital Wallets > Paze > Get started/Activate (redirects to the Paze site to accept the Paze Service Agreement).'

claim: Home-screen Zelle widget (3.3.0); Transfers widget (3.3.0); check-deposit widget on home since 3.3.0.
finding: App Store: 3.3.0 (09/19/2024) is 'Bug fixes and enhancements'. The widgets came in 3.2.0 (07/26/2024).
resolution: Replace '(3.3.0)' / 'since 3.3.0' with '(3.2.0, Jul 2024)' in TFC-J01/DISCOVER/1 touchpoint, TFC-P02 and TFC-P05 positioning.

finding: The 4.0.0 notes (02/26/2025) cover Assist, digital wallet, payee groupings, Plan & Track and rewards in Assist, with nothing on external-account linking. The gap-fill's verbatim App Store read (S919) puts 'Seamlessly manage and link your external accounts from the home screen' in 3.4.0 (11/14/2024). TFC-P02 positioning already says 3.4.0, so the journey contradicts its own product record.
resolution: TFC-J05/DISCOVER/1 action: "Transfer & Pay > 'Transfer money and pay Truist accounts' tile; or home-screen external-account linking (app 3.4.0, Nov 2024)".

claim: 'group payees (4.1.0)'; 'improved bill payment activity and confirmations (4.5.0)'; P03-S01 'payee groupings (app 4.1.0); payee list cleanup (4.6.0)'.
finding: App Store: payee groupings are in 4.0.0, improved bill-payment activity/confirmations in 4.4.0 (08/14/2025), and payee-list cleanup tools in 4.5.0 (09/10/2025).
resolution: J06/SET_UP/2 '(4.0.0)'; J06/EXECUTE_TRACK/5 '(4.4.0, Aug 2025)'; P03-S01 'payee groupings (app 4.0.0); payee list cleanup (4.5.0)'.

claim: Truist Assist 'accessible anywhere in app since 4.1.0'.
finding: App Store: 'Access Truist Assist ... from anywhere within the app' is a 4.0.0 (02/26/2025) note. 4.1.0 is bug fixes.
resolution: TFC-P08 positioning: '... accessible anywhere in app since 4.0.0 (Feb 2025)'.

claim: External transfer status: where 'Manage Transfers', states ['Scheduled','Pending','Completed'], evidence INFERRED.
finding: The current personal agreement (eff. 9/17/2026) states the status model directly: 'pending' until released, 'in process' until funds move, then 'complete'. 3-day transfers stay in process until the close of the third business day. The gap-fill quoted this from the 4/8 version but did not carry it into status_tracking.
resolution: TFC-J05 status_tracking: where_visible 'Log in to online/mobile banking (Manage Transfers)'; states ['Pending','In process','Complete'] ('Scheduled' for future-dated, inferred); evidence CONFIRMED_BANK; sources [S952, S907, S006].

claim: One View Connect: 'API-first embedded payments/reconciliation/reporting with in-ERP approvals ...; RTP initiation in-ERP'; rail RTP; dual_approval true. Strength: 'One View Connect embedded-ERP pilot with in-ERP RTP initiation'.
finding: The Oct 2025 IR release announced 'Real-Time Payments and approvals, directly within ERP platforms' as a pilot. The current public 'Truist One View Connect Features & Capabilities User Guide' (Rev. 04/26, 14 pp., read in the browser) only documents Information Reporting (balances, posted transactions, on-demand refresh and bank reconciliation in NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Dynamics 365 BC and Workday). It contains no payment initiation, RTP or approval content. The Treasury Resource Center page lists it under Platforms.
resolution: TFC-P10-S06 description: 'ERP-embedded banking built with Koxa for NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Workday and Dynamics 365 Business Central. Public user guide (Rev. 04/26) documents information reporting: real-time balances, posted transactions, on-demand refresh and native bank reconciliation. In-ERP Real-Time Payments and approvals were announced for the Oct 2025 pilot (IR release) but are not described in the public guide.' Keep rail RTP with notes 'announced (pilot)'. Set dual_approval_smb to 'unknown'. Reword the strength to 'One View Connect ERP-embedded information reporting (public guide) with in-ERP RTP and approvals announced in the Oct 2025 pilot'.

claim: Contract evidence cites the Online and Mobile Banking Service Agreements effective 4/8/2026 (personal S907, business S906).
finding: Both agreements have newer versions effective 9/17/2026 (linked from truist.com search results). I read both in full with pdf.js in the browser. The key clauses the chapter relies on are unchanged: Instant Transfers over an instant payment network at bank discretion; the RTP Instant Payment Bill Pay/RFP clause; per-wire OTP; domestic-only personal online wires; 7-calendar-day check retention; 'REIMBURSEMENT IS AVAILABLE FOR ... CERTAIN QUALIFYING IMPOSTER SCAMS'; ACH 8 pm ET deadline; Dual Approval Feature. New in the business version: an 'Approver Admin' role and the explicit 'must be enabled by the Business Profile Owner'.
resolution: Add S952/S953 as current-version sources alongside S906/S907 on the TFC-J05, J08, J09, J10, J11, J14 steps that rely on them. In J10/J14 REVIEW_AUTHORIZE, read the Dual Approval wording as: Approver or Approver Admin, feature enabled by the Business Profile Owner. No substantive capability changes.

claim: Open question: whether Wealth/Premier consumers can originate international wires online (Xe says yes).
finding: This can be answered now. The 9/17/2026 personal agreement limits the Wire Service to domestic wires: 'a payment order may be sent to initiate domestic wire transfers from eligible personal Accounts'. The personal fee schedule (eff. 09/28/2026) lists only online Outgoing Domestic ($20) and Book Transfer ($12) fees, with no online international fee. The Xe claim (S018) is contradicted.
resolution: Resolve the open question: personal online/mobile Wire Service = domestic wires (plus book transfers) for Truist Wealth and Premier relationships. Consumer international wires are teammate-assisted only ($65). S018's claim is contradicted.

finding: The bank's own Zelle page (S001) describes the live service and its navigation. Per the schema, the evidence level should be CONFIRMED_BANK.

claim: Small-business online international wires are USD only ('USD only online per 2022 doc').
finding: The only evidence is the 2022 SunTrust transition PDF ('international (US dollar) wire transfers'). The current business agreement (9/17/2026) reserves the bank's right to convert any wire to a local currency. The current fee schedule lists an online 'International Wire Transfer $35' with no currency restriction. Neither current source says whether the OLB form lets the user choose a foreign currency.
resolution: Keep the claim hedged as '(USD only per 2022 transition doc; current currency options unverified)'. A screenshot or help text of the current OLB international wire form showing a currency selector (or not) would settle it.

claim: Commercial payments run in 'Digital Treasury / Treasury Manager'; J17/J18 originate ACH and wires in Treasury Manager.
finding: The Treasury Resource Center 'Platforms' menu (read in the browser, Nov 6 2026) lists only Truist One View, Digital Treasury and Truist One View Connect. Treasury Manager (ex-SunView) no longer appears. The Treasury Manager evidence (S045) is a 2022 transition PDF. No retirement notice was found.
resolution: Keep J17/J18 but note 'Treasury Manager evidence dates from 2022; not listed among current Treasury Resource Center platforms (Nov 2026)'. A Truist notice of Treasury Manager retirement or migration, or a current Treasury Manager guide, would settle it.

finding: In Aug 2025 Truist added electronic direct deposit switching (with Atomic) to its digital account opening. It is money-movement-adjacent (moving payroll inflows to Truist). Reported by Zacks/Yahoo Finance (Dec 2025): 19% of digital applicants who used it completed the switch.
resolution: Add a recent change: 'Aug 2025: electronic direct deposit switching (Atomic) embedded in digital account opening; 19% of digital applicants who used it completed a switch (Zacks, Dec 2025) [S954].'
